evidence.excerpt: We introduce KU-PCP Elements (KU-PCPE), a label-conditioned region-evidence benchmark for photographic composition.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Given an image and a label already judged applicable, the task is to segment the visible regions that explain why the label applies.
